title: API keys
intro: Another program signs in to nexcrate with a key, for example Nexview, a dashboard or Home Assistant. Give every program its own key, then one can be revoked without disturbing the others.
empty: No key yet. While there is none, no other program gets into nexcrate.
usage: A program sends its key in the header Authorization: Bearer to the addresses under /api/v1, never in the address itself.
docs: Open the description of the interface

read.label: Read
read.hint: Read the library, versions, states, storage, health, the queue, problems, history and events. Every key has it.

request.label: Request
request.hint: Request titles and more of them, watch or freeze them, have them searched, take them back and move files into the recycle bin.

operate.label: Operate
operate.hint: Try stuck downloads again, remove them or have them searched again, confirm a path and assign files by hand.

add_dialog.title: New key
add_dialog.name: Name
add_dialog.nameHint: What the key is for, such as the name of the program.
add_dialog.never: No key reaches indexers, download clients, profiles, the account or stored secrets. There is no address for them under /api/v1.

created_dialog.title: Key for {{name}}
created_dialog.once: Copy the key now. nexcrate keeps only its fingerprint and cannot show it to you a second time.
created_dialog.how: Enter it in the other program. If it gets lost, revoke it and make a new one.

rename.title: Rename the key
rename.hint: The key itself and its scopes stay. For other scopes make a new key.

revoke.title: Revoke the key?
revoke.text: The key {{name}} stops working at once, and that cannot be taken back. The program that uses it needs a new one.

pairing.asks: {{app}} wants to connect to nexcrate. Code:
pairing.title: Connect {{app}}?
pairing.explain: {{app}} asks for a key to nexcrate. If you confirm, only the program gets to see the key; it then stands under API keys and can be revoked there.
pairing.compare: Does the program show the same code? If not, refuse.

app.title: Connect the iPhone app
app.scan: Open the nexcrate app on the iPhone, tap “Scan QR code” and point the camera at this code. The iPhone's camera app works too.
app.qr: QR code to connect the iPhone app
app.scopes: The app gets a key of its own with the scopes read, request and operate. It then stands in this list and can be revoked here.
app.address: The app connects to {{address}}. If the iPhone reaches nexcrate at another address, set it under System in “Address to the outside”.
app.waiting: Waiting for the app, {{minutes}} min left.
